headline: Singapore publishes quantum-safe migration milestones and pilot grant
summary: Singapore’s Cyber Security Agency published quantum-safe migration milestones and launched a pilot grant on 14 October. Non-CII organizations exposed to quantum risks are advised to prepare a migration plan by the end of 2027 and aim to complete migration by 2035. CII owners have a 31 March 2027 plan-submission deadline, a 31 December 2031 migration target, and quantum-safe procurement considerations from 2028. The Quantum-Safe Kickstarter Grant is open to Singapore-incorporated non-government organizations for Singapore-based work, prioritizes CII owners, and covers up to 70% of eligible costs with 30% cash co-funding; funded pilots may last up to six months during the 1 November 2026–31 October 2027 grant period. No award, completed pilot or migration outcome is established.
